<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that converts the amine product back to a nitro precursor. Using the product SMILES, we search the template catalog for templates where a nitro group is broken in the forward reaction (i.e., nitro → amine). This should give us the appropriate template ID to apply.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
